notes: North is up. Printed names: 'W. DANIELS', 'BISHOP ST.' (north of Daniels, the 263 overlap), 'DENNIS', 'PECAN', 'HOPSON', 'ALICE', 'SCIOTO', 'W. CHARLTON', 'W. CORRY'; suffix-less names written with 'Street', and the spellings of 263 and 260 are used ('Dennis Street (south of Daniels)' for the 40' street that leaves Daniels ~137 px east of Dennis's line and runs SSE to Corry; 'Dennis Street (south of Corry)' for the N-S piece south of Corry, as on 260). The strip north of Daniels is the bottom of sheet 263: Dennis (x~2000-2242), Bishop (2857-3095), Alice and Scioto are drawn there, so the Daniels crossings are repeated here at this sheet's coordinates (also picked on 263). Bishop ends at Daniels (T; block 2 lot lines continue across its line). Alice (40') runs from Daniels south to Charlton and ends there; Charlton begins at Alice (its north line starts at Alice's east line and the Dennis-east block closes it on the west), so Alice/Charlton is an L-corner recorded as T. Scioto (60') crosses Daniels, Charlton and Corry. The Dennis and Pecan diagonals both curve; their centrelines follow the 4" water pipes, and bends are recorded along them. Pecan opens onto the park at its NW end. Hopson (30') runs from a closed north end (y~3895) south to Corry (T). The Dennis diagonal and the N-S Dennis south of Corry meet Corry ~145 px apart (two T points; the water pipe jogs between them); on 260 the same gap measures ~130 px. Daniels: lines y~880/1244 at the west, ~853/1220 at Scioto. Corry: lines y~6486/6850 in the west, ~6518/6882 at Scioto. The bottom strip below Corry is the top of sheet 260. Block 1 (between Pecan and Dennis) and block 4 (west of Pecan) have no alleys. Circled figures are grade elevations.
